mostWorthwhile.text: Recording the doorway was most worthwhile: it clearly showed how a photograph can be physically connected to a scene yet limited by viewpoint.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making copies felt comparatively predictable; it extended access without adding much to the initial insight about the selected view.
